summary: Female hiker separated from party in thunderstorm on Culebra Peak, descended wrong drainage (False summit-Red Mountain), spent night unprepared; found next day with minor injuries, treated and released
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR (+ Flight for Life / REACH Air Medical)
notes: Saturday-verified; group of 4 split during storm; located by ground-team voice contact + REACH helo ~2030h; run 804
